app.tagline: Camera & tech deals — buy at the right moment.

cookies.title: Cookies & privacy
cookies.message: We use essential local storage and session mechanisms so you can sign in and use Pricefly. If you choose “Accept all”, we also load self-hosted Umami analytics (privacy-friendly, no advertising cookies). You can choose “Essential only” to skip analytics.

hero.title: Track camera & tech prices —
hero.sub: Pricefly uses prices from a partner product catalog. Search for a product, add it, and optionally set price thresholds plus email or push notifications. Automatic checks run once per day for all products together; you can also refresh any item manually at any time.

steps.title: How Pricefly actually works
steps.sub: Three steps as in the app — no buzzwords.

step1.title: 1. Find a product in the catalog
step1.body: Search by name, keyword, or a shop URL from the feed, then pick a result. Data comes from your imported partner catalog — not arbitrary store URLs.

step2.title: 2. Set alerts (optional)
step2.body: Choose lower and/or upper price limits and enable email or system notifications (Web Push) where your plan and server configuration allow.

step3.title: 3. Follow the price and buy
step3.body: We refresh all active catalog trackings once per day. You can refresh manually anytime. Purchase via the merchant link shown in the app.

facts.title: What the app really offers
facts.a: Prices from the imported partner catalog — not “paste any URL and scrape the page”.
facts.b: Automatic check once per day for all products; you choose the time of day and time zone in the app.
facts.d: Plan limits (e.g. number of trackings, email alerts) — see Pricing.

cta.title: Ready?
cta.sub: Sign up free, search the catalog, and set price alerts.
cta.note: No credit card required to get started. Terms and privacy policy apply.

affiliate.title: Affiliate note:
affiliate.body: Offers may use affiliate programs; that usually does not change the price you pay. The app uses your imported feed — we do not pick products by commission in the UI.

fairUse.title: Fair use policy
fairUse.updated: This policy applies to everyone using Pricefly.
fairUse.p1: Pricefly is provided for personal, non-abusive use. We may rate-limit, throttle, or suspend accounts that generate excessive automated traffic, strain our infrastructure, or harm other users.
fairUse.p2: Email notifications are optional and capped per plan so we can keep delivery reliable: up to 2 tracked products on Free and up to 10 on Pro. In-app notifications and web push alerts are not subject to these per-product email caps.
fairUse.p3: You agree not to misuse the service, including attempting to circumvent limits, scrape our API without authorization, or use Pricefly to harass others.
fairUse.li1: Respect robots.txt and each store’s terms when adding product URLs.
fairUse.li3: We may update this policy; continued use means you accept the current version.
fairUse.p4: Questions? Contact us using the support channel listed on our site.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.updated: Effective: March 2026 — applies to your use of Pricefly.
terms.notLegalAdvice: This document is not a substitute for legal advice tailored to your situation.

scope.title: 1. Scope and contractual partner
scope.body:
These Terms of Service govern use of the online service “Pricefly” (price monitoring and notifications), available via our website and related web applications (PWA), where applicable.

The provider is the entity listed in the Imprint (legal notice). By using the service (including registering, signing in, or actively using features), you agree to these Terms, except where mandatory law provides otherwise.

service.title: 2. Service description
service.body:
Pricefly lets you add product URLs and receive information (e.g. product titles, prices, identifiable shop hints) retrieved at intervals or subject to technical constraints from publicly reachable pages, and provides related notifications.

The service is offered only as technical assistance for informational overview. We do not warrant completeness, timeliness, or uninterrupted availability of individual features.

priceData.title: 3. Price and product information (no warranty)
priceData.intro: Displayed prices and product data come from third-party websites and are processed automatically or semi-automatically. In particular:
priceData.li1: Prices may be missed, misread, shown out of date, or differ from the source due to region settings, cookies, paywalls, or JavaScript behavior.
priceData.li2: Shops may change content or structure or block access, so data may be missing or wrong temporarily or permanently.
priceData.li3: Notifications (email, push, in-app) may be delayed or fail to deliver for technical reasons.
priceData.li4: Historical values are indicative only and may not reflect actual checkout prices.
priceData.outro: You are responsible for verifying prices and conditions with the seller before purchase. Pricefly is not a price guarantee and does not replace your own checks.

thirdPartyUrls.title: Responsibility for shop URLs you add
thirdPartyUrls.body:
You are solely responsible for ensuring that storing and repeatedly retrieving the product URLs you submit is permitted towards each site operator (for example under their terms of use, robots.txt, and applicable law).

Pricefly fetches publicly reachable pages using technical means (HTTP requests; optionally a headless browser) to determine prices and detectable product data. We do not decide on a case-by-case basis whether your use is allowed by a particular shop.

You must not use the service to bypass protected areas (e.g. after login), paywalls, or technical protection measures, or to place abusive load on third-party servers or our infrastructure (see the fair use policy).

availability.title: 4. Availability and technical faults
availability.body:
We strive for reliable operation but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free availability. Maintenance, updates, infrastructure incidents, security measures, or force majeure may cause downtime or limited functionality.

Use is on an “as is” basis, to the extent permitted by law; there is no claim to a specific feature set beyond what we describe for the product.

account.title: 5. User accounts, fair use, and suspension
account.body:
Certain features require an account. You must provide accurate information and keep credentials confidential.

By registering, you confirm that you have read and accept these Terms of Service.

Abuse (e.g. bypassing limits, excessive automated load on our systems, unlawful use) is prohibited. We may restrict or terminate accounts at our reasonable discretion. Our fair use policy provides additional detail.

paid.title: 6. Paid plan (Pro) and billing
paid.body:
Optional paid services (e.g. a Pro subscription) are billed through the payment provider shown at checkout (e.g. PayPal). Their terms also apply to the payment relationship.

Refund and statutory cancellation rights follow applicable law and the payment/subscription provider’s terms, where relevant.

liability.title: 7. Liability
liability.body:
We have unlimited liability under statutory rules for intent and gross negligence, and for injury to life, body, or health.

For breach of essential contractual obligations caused by slight negligence, we are liable only for typically foreseeable contract damage; for other slight negligence we are not liable.

These limitations do not apply where mandatory law provides otherwise.

To the extent permitted by law, claims for lost profit, indirect damage, or consequential damage from incorrect prices, missed alerts, or downtime are excluded unless we acted intentionally or with gross negligence.

changes.title: 8. Changes to these terms
changes.body:
We may update these Terms if there is good cause (e.g. legal changes, service development). Where reasonable, we will notify you of material changes (e.g. on the website or by email).

If you do not object within a stated period and continue to use the service, the new version may be deemed accepted where permitted by law; we will inform you separately about statutory objection rights where required.

law.title: 9. Governing law
law.body:
German law applies, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG), except where mandatory consumer protection law of your EU/EEA country prevails.

If you are a merchant, a legal entity under public law, or a special fund under public law, the exclusive place of jurisdiction is the provider’s seat as stated in the Imprint, where permitted. Consumers are governed by statutory jurisdiction rules.

errors.priceNotFound5: The witness (the DOM) took the fifth. No sale price on the record. (On this page, automated scraping is blocked or forbidden.)
errors.priceNotFound6: The trail ran cold somewhere between "networkidle" and a very firm corporate policy. (On this page, automated scraping is blocked or forbidden.)
errors.priceNotFound7: We knocked on the server door; someone slid a note under it: "not for bots, bestie." (On this page, automated scraping is blocked or forbidden.)
errors.priceNotFound8: Plot twist: the price was inside us all along — no, false alarm, it is absolutely nowhere. (On this page, automated scraping is blocked or forbidden.)
errors.priceNotFound9: Forensic accounting has left the chat; this page is simply not sharing. (On this page, automated scraping is blocked or forbidden.)

collection.title: 2. Categories of personal data
collection.intro: We process personal data only where necessary to provide Pricefly. This includes in particular:
collection.li1: Account data: e-mail address, password hash, plan status, PayPal subscription reference where applicable
collection.li2: Product data you add: URLs you track, scraped product names/prices, your labels and alert settings
collection.li3: Communication data: e-mails via Brevo (registration confirmation link = double opt-in, welcome mail after confirmation, optional price alerts) and technical logs
collection.li4: Payment-related data processed by PayPal when you subscribe (we do not receive your full payment credentials)
collection.li5: Web Push: push subscription endpoints and keys stored for delivering browser notifications if you opt in
collection.li6: Usage data: IP address, timestamps, browser type where technically required (e.g. security, abuse prevention)
collection.li7: Optional analytics: if you consent, aggregated visit statistics via self-hosted Umami (see cookie section)
collection.li8: Third-party page requests: to refresh prices, our backend retrieves the public product pages you add. Technical data (e.g. timestamps, response metadata) may appear in our logs; the respective shops process those requests under their own policies.

legalBasis.title: 3. Legal basis
legalBasis.li1: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR) — operating your account and the service you request
legalBasis.li2: Compliance with legal obligations (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. c GDPR) where applicable
legalBasis.li3: Legitimate interests (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR) — e.g. securing the service, preventing abuse, improving stability
legalBasis.li4: Consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR) — e.g. optional analytics after you choose “Accept all” in the cookie banner

storage.title: 4. Storage duration
storage.body: We store data only as long as necessary for the respective purpose or as required by statutory retention periods. Account and tracking data are kept until you delete content or your account, subject to legal retention rules.

recipients.li5: Self-hosted Umami (only after consent — aggregated statistics)
recipients.paypalNote: PayPal processes payment data on their own terms. Details:

cookies.title: 7. Cookies, local storage and analytics
cookies.usage: We use technically necessary mechanisms (e.g. authentication tokens, local preferences) so Pricefly works. Where Cloudflare is used in front of our site, it may set technically required cookies (e.g. bot management). The cookie banner records your choice regarding optional analytics.
cookies.analytics: Umami is only loaded after you choose “Accept all”. It is self-hosted and oriented toward aggregated, privacy-friendly statistics.
cookies.cloudflareWhat: We use Cloudflare for website delivery, DDoS protection and performance. Cloudflare may process IP addresses and request data and set cookies (e.g. __cf_bm, cf_clearance). Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR).
cookies.umamiWhat: If enabled, we collect anonymized or pseudonymous usage data such as page views and coarse technical information, depending on your Umami configuration.
cookies.umamiBasis: Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR).
cookies.umamiOptOut: To opt out later, choose “Essential only” in the banner (clear site data / revisit in a private window if needed) or delete stored consent in your browser.

security.title: 8. Security
security.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss or alteration, subject to the state of the art and implementation context.

changes.title: 9. Changes
changes.body: We may update this privacy policy when the service or legal requirements change. The version published here applies.
